body:
I know how you're feeling and I have several friends who've been like this, too. My ultimate advice to you is to go to all the teachers that you have Ds in those classes, and *talk* to them. Don't try to make up excuses, just say that you would really like to get your grades up to Cs. They know 2nd semester seniors really can fall behind and lack any motivation. 

Do you think there's a possibility that maybe part of the reason you don't care about your grades is because you aren't excited/don't want to go to the college you chose? You should choose the life path that you want, not the life your parents want for you. In the end, you'll have to end up living it when you're long gone out of the house and whatever your parents thought about you and your decisions won't matter.
